implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.on_key checks for space/Up/w and calls self.bird.flap(); also on_click does the same.
Bird.update applies GRAVITY, caps fall speed, updates y position, and sets alive=False on ground contact.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Random pipe generation with vertical gaps
implemented_requirements.evidence: Pipe.__init__ computes gap = BASE_GAP - score*GAP_SHRINK + random.randint(-GAP_VARIANCE, GAP_VARIANCE) and random top position.
In Game.update, when p.x + PIPE_W < self.bird.x and not p.passed, score is increased.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Collision detection with pipes and ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Pipe.collides uses bird.collides(self.rects()); Bird.update marks alive=False when hitting floor; Game.update calls game_over on collision or dead bird.
Game.game_over sets state='over' and updates best score; Game.update stops processing when state!='play'.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Difficulty scaling (gap size and speed) with score
implemented_requirements.evidence: Pipe.speed = min(BASE_SPEED + score * SPEED_GAIN, MAX_SPEED); gap size shrinks with score via GAP_SHRINK.
Game.loop calls update() and draw() then schedules itself with root.after(FPS_MS, self.loop); Game.run starts mainloop.

judge.summary: The provided code implements a functional Flappy Bird clone: key‑based flapping, gravity, randomly generated pipe gaps, scoring on successful passes, collision detection with pipes and ground, game‑over logic, and progressive difficulty via faster pipes and smaller gaps. All core requirements are present and the program is likely to run under a standard Python environment with tkinter.
